tenants.create.description: Provision a tenant: write the tenant and register it (enabled) in the tenant directory; the administrator is created with tenants.initialize-admin. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenants.create. Without an edition the default edition applies (an error if there is none).
tenants.get.description: Get a tenant with its administrator's user name and user count. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.
tenants.list.description: List tenants with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.
tenants.update.description: Update a tenant's name, description, expiry and order; the name is mirrored to the directory. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.
tenants.suspend.description: Suspend tenants in batch: the directory marks them disabled, their users cannot sign in and calls carrying the tenant are rejected. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.
tenants.resume.description: Resume suspended tenants in batch. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.
tenants.delete.description: Delete tenants in batch and remove them from the directory; tenants that still have users are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.tenants.delete.
tenants.initialize_admin.description: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission; the password must be changed at first sign-in. Once per tenant. Requires tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.
tenancy.tenant.has_users: Tenant '{tenantId}' still has {count} users and cannot be deleted.
tenancy.tenant.platform_only: Tenants are managed from the platform side only.
tenancy.admin.name_taken: User name '{userName}' is already taken in this tenant.
tenancy.tenant.no_initializer: No tenant initializer is configured; the administrator would have no permissions.
tenants.mine.description: Tenants the current user can enter (home tenant and memberships, active only) and whether the platform is available; the control center switches with auth.switch-tenant.
tenant_members.list.description: List a tenant's members (users whose home tenant is elsewhere and who enter it by membership) with user name and display name. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.read.
tenant_members.create.description: Add a user as a tenant member; rejected when the user is already a member or the tenant is the user's home. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.create.
tenant_members.delete.description: Remove tenant members in batch; they can no longer switch into the tenant. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.delete.
tenancy.member.exists: User '{userId}' is already a member of tenant '{tenantId}' (or it is their home tenant).
editions.list.description: List every edition (by order, then code) with its whitelist size and the number of tenants on it. Platform side only; requires tenancy.editions.read.
editions.get.description: Get an edition with its permission whitelist. Requires tenancy.editions.read.
editions.create.description: Create an edition with an initial whitelist (tenant-side permissions only); it can become the default edition for new tenants. Requires tenancy.editions.create.
editions.update.description: Update an edition's name, description, default flag and order; the code cannot change. Requires tenancy.editions.update.
editions.set_permissions.description: Replace an edition's permission whitelist; the effective permissions of tenants on it narrow or widen immediately. Requires tenancy.editions.update.
editions.delete.description: Delete editions and their whitelists in batch; editions still used by tenants are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.editions.delete.
tenants.change_edition.description: Move a tenant to another edition, or lift edition limits; its users' effective permissions follow the new whitelist immediately. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.
tenancy.edition.in_use: Edition '{code}' is still used by tenants and cannot be deleted.
tenancy.edition.permission_invalid: Permission '{code}' is not a tenant-side permission in the catalog and cannot be put into an edition.
tenancy.edition.no_default: There is no default edition; specify one when creating a tenant.
